headline: Kenya: banks request postponement of new capital requirements to 2028
summary: Kenya's commercial banks are asking the Central Bank of Kenya to postpone by one year, to January 2028, new capital rules for systemically important institutions. The banks say the delay would let them adapt without curbing lending.
why: Capital requirements set how much equity banks must hold against their loans, which shapes lending capacity and bank profitability. The Central Bank of Kenya sets these rules for the country's lenders.
original_headline: Kenya : les banques demandent un report des nouvelles exigences de fonds propres à 2028
